summary: Refactor-verification pass for the 11 N+1 → batched endpoints. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py (13 tests, all pass) exercising every rewritten endpoint against expected shape/counts, then verified each surface in the UI. All rewritten payloads survive the UI. Concrete UI verifications: (1) TARA /dashboard renders 11 event-card testids (7 bookings + related) with titles/dates/prices; (2) AARAV /messages shows exactly the 4 threads named Diya Sharma, Kabir Nair, Street Food Crawl: Old Delhi (group), Vivaan Chopra with unread=0, opening Diya thread loads message bubbles with sender names/avatars; (3) GUEST /events → Top rated tab renders card ratings (4.67) + review highlight snippet with first name + comment (KUNAL / TARA), Rooftop Jazz & Tapas Night detail page shows 4.67 (6) rating, 6 participant avatars, reviews-section; (4) MEMBER /discover renders 12 discover-card-* testids; (5) ADMIN /admin → Payouts tab lists 2 payouts (Nightfall Collective / Supper Club Regional Thali Trail paid ₹11,215, Rooftop Jazz & Tapas Night paid ₹13,250), Reviews shows TOTAL REVIEWS 9 header; (6) PARTNER /partner portal loads with Participants tab (needs event selection – UX hint present); (7) /leaderboard (Tara logged in) shows 5 ranked rows with badges (Tara J. Ambassador 9 invites, Sofia M. Ambassador 4, Liam O. Ambassador 3, Kabir N. Connector 2, Omar R. Starter 1), July 2026 champion card (Sofia M., Won Festival Season Pass), 'You're #1 this month' personal block, names shortened; (8) /city/delhi-ncr renders quotes 'Superb hosting…' — TARA J. · DELHI NCR and 'Brilliant evening…' — ANANYA K. · DELHI NCR; /city/gurugram renders KUNAL B. and ARJUN S. quotes; /city/dubai loads without a quotes block, events + guide render fine. Mobile 390x844 /dashboard and /messages both scrollWidth==innerWidth (no horizontal overflow). No NEW console errors introduced — the only console noise is the pre-existing <span>-in-<option> hydration warning on /events (already noted in iteration_9) and a pre-existing empty-string src warning. Backend suite serial run: 13/13 pass.
action_items: Optional data-hygiene: a leftover published event titled 'TEST Partner Event 761e12' is showing up on /city/delhi-ncr's 'Coming up in Delhi NCR' section (upcoming date Jan 1, 2030). It is polluting a public page — created by an earlier automated suite, not by this iteration. Purge it (and any other TEST_*/TEST prefixed published events) from the events collection.
Cosmetic (pre-existing, carried over from iteration_9): clean up the <span> inside <option> in Events.jsx price/city selects to silence the hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Leaderboard 'invites' column now shows 9 for Tara (spec said 6) — this is not a code regression, seed_referrals.py was rerun against container clock=Aug 2026 and the new lifetime aggregation drives Kabir's badge from Starter → Connector correctly. Data drift, not logic drift.

The `load_many` helper is used consistently across the 11 rewritten endpoints; response shapes are stable (verified: me/events {items}, conversations {items}, conversations/{cid}/messages {items with sender_name}, events top_review {rating, comment, user_name}, event detail participants[], discover [], referrals/leaderboard {items, month, prize, reward}, admin/reviews {items with event_title/author_name/reports[], total}, admin/payouts {items with partner{full_name}, event_title}, partner/events/{id}/participants {items}, cities/{slug} quotes[]).

admin/payouts now returns `partner` as an embedded object (with full_name) rather than a flat `partner_name` string. The UI reads .partner.full_name correctly — no consumer regression seen, but worth documenting for any external API clients.
test_credentials: Used tara.joshi@example.com, aarav.mehta@example.com, admin@buddilio.com, partner@buddilio.com — all `User@123` / `Admin@123` / `Partner@123` as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: None. However my probe of the Diya thread sent one test message 'TEST refactor check ping abc123' — send button locator missed on that step so the message was NOT actually posted (verified by reading /api/conversations/{cid}/messages after — no new bubble). No DB writes from this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file for this refactor lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py — run with `pytest -o addopts='' backend/tests/test_iteration10.py` (the default addopts adds xdist which the preview ingress occasionally drops). Response shapes to remember: /api/events uses {items,total,page}; /api/conversations uses {items}; /api/admin/reviews uses {items,total,flagged,hidden}; /api/admin/payouts uses {items} with each row having a nested `partner` object; /api/referrals/leaderboard uses {items, month, prize, reward}. Leaderboard for Aug 2026: Tara J. has 9 invites (not 6 as older specs said — seed_referrals drift). Kabir N. is now Connector (was Starter) — because badge is computed from lifetime aggregation, which is the exact change this iteration verified. There is a leftover published event 'TEST Partner Event 761e12' polluting /city/delhi-ncr — pre-existing, main agent should purge. Login button is <button>Log in</button> (no type='submit'), use get_by_role('button', name='Log in'). /events has tab-style sort buttons (All/Upcoming/Past & rated/By date/Most popular/Top rated), not a <select>.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regression found. The three deltas from the spec's expected numbers (Tara 9 vs 6 invites, Kabir Connector vs Starter, 21 vs 19 Diya messages) are all explainable data drift: seeded referrals + prior test-message pollution — none are caused by the batched-lookup rewrites.
